candidates.snippet: The Memory model builds a binary tree of one-line summaries over the journal, in the background. It first compresses each entry into a line of at most 512 bytes. Then it merges adjacent lines in pairs: two lines become one line covering both, two of those become one covering four, and so on up. An entry or a pair of lines short enough to fit in 512 bytes is kept word for word, with no model call.
